text:
natalie: Quick heads-up: live release of redwood-demoshelf v0.1.0 just went out. It's a small repo of 6 demo apps (chat widget, docs search, agent playground, embeddings explorer) with deployable examples and per-demo perf notes. Link + install below. We're pairing the release with a "Demoshelf Demo Night" on Thursday 6pm PT — bring a demo or come watch.

release-bot: Release published: redwood-inference/redwood-demoshelf v0.1.0
https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-demoshelf/releases/tag/v0.1.0
Changelog: add 6 demos, per-demo perf pages, simple docker dev image, CONTRIBUTING guide for community demos.

natalie: Quick start (run the chat widget demo locally):
```bash
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-demoshelf.git
cd demoshelf/chat-widget
docker build -t rd-demo-chat .
docker run -p 3000:3000 -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=yourkey rd-demo-chat
# open http://localhost:3000
```

june: License set to Apache-2.0 to match community contrib policy?

natalie: Yep Apache-2.0, CONTRIBUTING notes include DCO + CLA guidance.

ryan: Any plan for tagging demos with recommended model profiles / quantization? would help users pick a ready config.

emily: I've added a PERF.md per demo with recommended model families and sequence length notes. We'll iterate with community feedback.

oliver: Nice. Do we want to surface a RSS/atom feed for new demos (for community watchers)?

devrel-bot: Demo Night RSVP + signup to present: https://forms.gle/example-demoshelf (indicate which demo you want to show and if you need a co-host)

natalie: For maintainers: please review MAINTAINERS.md and the demo submission checklist. If you're on-call this week, a quick skim would be great before Demo Night.

ryan: I'll do a short walkthrough of the agent playground demo. 5-7 min.

emily: I'll show embeddings explorer.

natalie: Blurb for newsletter: "redwood-demoshelf v0.1 — six deployable demo apps showing quick integrations and perf notes. Join Demo Night Thu 6pm PT for live walkthroughs."

oliver: :raised_hands: adding it to the events calendar now.

natalie: Thanks all. If you're submitting a community demo PR, add a short README and PERF.md. See you Thursday. :rocket:
